comment: The tooltip on the sixth mute button reads 'Mute #+' rather than 'Mute #6' (PolyMuter16.cpp:78). Shrink channels bypasses the fade entirely. 'exclude -10v chans too' tests the channel voltage against -10V, so a channel at exactly -10V is dropped. The IN and OUT jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family.
